0022600002.text: Both the New York Knicks and Philadelphia 76ers open their 2026-27 seasons in this game at Madison Square Garden, where the Knicks are the home team. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti, who is out with a ruptured Achilles, and Adem Bona (foot sprain) and Anfernee Simons (hamstring) are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, and the most recent meeting was a 144-114 Knicks win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Knicks a 55% chance of winning.
